groups.builder-and-delegation: PlayerInfo private fields preserve every owned part when each consuming builder adds the missing trait part. No arithmetic/index or partially committed external mutation; unit marker controls method availability. Derive/delegation forwards actual trait contract rather than validating all part values, and does not itself seal a coherent combat state. Lossless impl Into<Attribute> dispatch is appropriate enum composition, not a primitive-erasure port.
groups.forwarded-operation-graph: fatigue/weighted limb attr/attr/skill_check and melee/ranged resolution forward actual constituents directly; their computed result guarantees remain lower helper obligations. Raw hit precision/flanking/skill outputs cross internal APIs and must join canonical shared owner propagation. Same Self defender type constrains component types, not two players' value validity or identity.
groups.contact-computation: melee_contact_location computes gap_targeting=(accuracy-1).clamp0..1 times ContactPrecision concentrated fraction; finite nonnegative accuracy/precision contract needed before this calculation. ContactPrecision::new is an assertion-bearing late admission for raw trait weapon_precision; joins F014/F025 physical precision graph, no independent normal failure asserted. The final equipment sampling helper does not make preceding NaN/Inf safe.
groups.scope-and-docs: Read all existing doctest/example source as scoped content; no new or executed tests/helpers. Existing fatigue/combat method behavior stays delegated; no separate fatigue pool or tactical persistence. This operations record grants no general trait implementor/default-body/underlying combat module clearance.
